Girls basketball in Copenhagen, ages 6 to 14

Talata Sparks is our girls only group for ages 6 to 14. Mondays at Strandvejsskolen on Østerbro, coached by Deng with our older girls helping. Most girls start with no experience at all.

Ages
Girls 6 to 14. No experience needed
When
Mon 15:30 to 16:30 at Strandvejsskolen
Where
Strandvejsskolen, Sionsgade 1, 2100 København Ø
Price
1.200 kr per half-season for Sparks on its own
Girls 15+
The Stevnsgade girls team at Nørrebrohallen
Book a trial

Talata Sparks

Sparks is part of Talata Girls. For one hour the gym belongs to the girls, and it changes how they play. Nobody hides at the back and nobody waits around for a turn.

Most girls who join have never played before. She will be moving almost the whole hour, learning the basics at the level a 6 year old can manage. The group is small, so the coaches know every girl by name.

The Big Sisters

Our U17 and U19 girls, the Big Sisters, help lead every Sparks session. They have been exactly where the little ones are now, and every Spark has an older girl in her corner from day one.

The older girls take leading seriously. A teenager who plays and is on her side shows a 7 year old what she can become. It is the main reason girls stay with us.

Girls 15 and up at Nørrebrohallen

Sparks runs to 14. From 15, girls train with the Stevnsgade girls team, coached by Deng. The team plays KU17, the under 17 girls league, with home games at Nørrebrohallen.
